samlFieldsObserved: Configuration name* — 'Use something you'll recognize, like the identity provider name.'
SAML SSO URL* — URL Zendesk invokes to redirect users to your identity provider; ACS URL is https://<subdomain>.zendesk.com/access/saml
Certificate fingerprint* — SHA256 fingerprint of the SAML certificate, obtained from the SAML identity provider
Remote logout URL — URL Zendesk redirects users to after they sign out (example: https://www.example.com/services/logout)
IP ranges — requests from these ranges always routed via remote authentication; blank means all; supports n.n.n.n, asterisk wildcard, space-separated multiples
